title: Sync toggle control and core config classification (F-002 + F-003)
description: Implement 2 features: (1) A global sync toggle stored in globalState (key: dish_config_sync_toggle, default false) controlling whether Feature Config writes to settings.json. When toggle transitions OFF->ON, immediately sync all non-default Feature Config. When ON->OFF, stop future sync but do not delete existing entries. (2) Core config classification (isCoreConfigKey/isFeatureConfigKey) that ensures base.* and providers.* always sync regardless of toggle state. The toggle UI is a banner at top of Features tab.

criteria: SettingsSyncService has 2 exported functions: isCoreConfigKey(dotPath) and isFeatureConfigKey(dotPath)
isSyncEnabled getter reads from globalState with default false
setSyncEnabled(true) triggers immediate full sync of non-default Feature Config
setSyncEnabled(false) returns without deleting existing entries
syncFeaturesToSettingsJson checks: core keys always sync, feature keys check toggle
Features tab shows sync toggle banner at top with Switch control
2 new UIRequest enum values: GetSyncToggleState, SetSyncToggleState
Existing user detection in initialize(): if globalState has feature data, default toggle ON
convergence.definition_of_done: Sync toggle gates Feature Config sync, Core Config always syncs, toggle UI visible in Features tab

rationale.why: Sync toggle gives users control over settings.json writes; core config classification ensures essential settings are always discoverable
rationale.approach: Toggle in globalState to avoid circular dependency; prefix-based classification for simplicity

risks.risk: User disables sync then manually edits settings.json
risks.mitigation: Direction A (settings.json -> globalState) is NOT gated by toggle - manual edits are respected
